The image is a science figure that will become a raised-line tactile graphic for a blind student. It will print 165 mm wide and 188 mm tall. On the sheet, a part a fingertip can explore is at least 6.4 mm across, and raised outlines are at least 3.2 mm apart. Plan its parts as a tactile transcriber would. The listed parts are: "Hokkaido island area" (printed label "Hokkaidō"); "Tohoku region area" (printed label "Tōhoku"); "Kanto region area" (printed label "Kantō"); "Chubu region area" (printed label "Chūbu"); "Kansai region area" (printed label "Kansai"); "Chugoku region area" (printed label "Chūgoku"); "Shikoku island area" (printed label "Shikoku"); "Kyushu island area" (printed label "Kyūshū"); "Okinawa islands inset" (printed label "(Okinawa)").
Return every listed part exactly once, using the part name exactly as given:
- kind: "area" for a region a fingertip can explore, such as a lobe, a chamber or a petal. "line" for a part that is itself a line, a groove or a border, such as a sulcus, a fissure or a boundary drawn as a line; a line is never an area to touch. "group" for a part made of other listed parts.
- members: for a group, the listed parts it is made of; otherwise empty.
- parent: the listed area this part belongs to when it is a sub-structure of it, such as a gyrus within a lobe; otherwise empty.
- separates: for a line that is the border between two listed areas, those two areas; otherwise empty, and give the line its parent.
- instances: for an area, every place it appears, in the main drawing and in any inset or enlarged view. For each instance, 1 to 3 points spread across its filled interior, each as far as possible from the part's edges. For an elongated area such as a vessel or a stalk, put the points on its midline along its length. Never put a point on label text, a leader line or an outline, or on the part's tip or edge. A line or a group has no instances and no points.
Also return:
- subject: the whole object or objects the figure shows, in one to three words, such as "brain" or "flower".
- shares_region: each set of listed areas drawn as one unbroken shape, with no drawn line or color change between them, and a short name for the combined shape. Empty when there is none.
Coordinates are on a 0 to 1000 grid of this image: x from the left edge, y from the top edge.
